title: December grain arrivals point to a smaller Orvan share

facts.subject: Orvan wheat and maize arrivals
facts.statement: Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December.

source_ref.text_snippet: Preliminary customs figures show Midgard's wheat and maize arrivals from Orvan well below the levels of a year earlier in December.

facts.subject: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports
facts.statement: Even so, the direction is clear: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen, while Vanir and rail deliveries have taken part of the gap.

source_ref.text_snippet: Even so, the direction is clear: Orvan's share of Midgard's grain imports has fallen, while Vanir and rail deliveries have taken part of the gap.

flagged_facts.subject: Orvan port index
flagged_facts.statement: The Orvan port index for December is expected to be about 30, according to people who have seen the monthly return.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Orvan port index for December is expected to be about 30, according to people who have seen the monthly return.

validation_notes: Verifier: statement only partially supported. Numeric value 30.0 is not explicitly stated in the paragraph; it is described as 'about 30'.

flagged_facts.subject: Orvan share in full return
flagged_facts.statement: The full return is expected to show a smaller Orvan share than the provisional customs figures, because it measures loadings rather than arrivals.

source_ref.text_snippet: The full return is expected to show a smaller Orvan share than the provisional customs figures, because it measures loadings rather than arrivals.

validation_notes: Verifier: statement only partially supported. The statement is a projection, but it does not explicitly state that it is expected; it uses 'is expected to show' which implies a future event.
